answer: In PoA, reputation decays with an exponential temporal half-life, so influence persists only through sustained, honestly validated service. EigenTrust factorization assigns each identity centrality from weighted peer attestations; a freshly spawned sybil vertex has near-zero mass because it lacks trusted inbound support. Even if it imitates an atlas or floods the ocean with claims, reciprocity-weighted transitivity cannot amplify unearned trust, preventing it from passing consensus.
